raw_meta_yaml:
{% set python_min = "3.10" %}
{% set name = "vidigi" %}
{% set version = "1.3.1" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/vidigi-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 2a96986121366ac51cabbc2301c6ab9cf53d63a45b4fc5af43c4843f3679f10d

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - hatchling
    - pip
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - plotly >=5.12.0,<7.0.0
    - numpy >=1.26.2,<3.0.0
    - pandas >=2.0.1,<3.0.0
    - simpy >=4.0.0,<5.0.0
    - pydantic >=2.0.0,<3.0.0
    - webcolors >=24.11.1
    - python-graphviz >=0.15,<1.0.0
    - ipywidgets >=8.0.0
    - ipycytoscape >=1.2.0,<2.0.0
    - packaging >=21.0
  run_constrained:
    - graphviz >=2.50

test:
  imports:
    - vidigi
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://hsma-tools.github.io/vidigi/vidigi_docs/
  summary: A package for creating animated visualisations of queues and pathways from historical data or simulations
  dev_url: https://github.com/hsma-tools/vidigi
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.md

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - Bergam0t
